summary: Enterprise Visibility (EXECUTION ORDER 002 · V2 Dashboard Inspector + V3 Enterprise Explorer + Architecture Navigator) fully validated end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest passed — /api/founder/knowledge/inspector/{widget_id} for all 6 widgets (ceo.enterprise_status, ceo.one_thing, ceo.autonomous_execution, health.overall, ops.autonomous_followup, warroom.mission100) returns full schema (name/purpose/business_value/inputs/outputs/engine{name}/api/database[]/cron/documents[]/related_dashboards[]/truth_classification/dependencies[]) with each edge carrying source_name/target_name/evidence; unknown widget → 404, admin → 403, unauth → 401. /api/founder/knowledge/architecture returns 11 blocks (system_zero…client) with layer/description/files/routes/api/database/next; admin → 403, unauth → 401. Registry regression: 46 nodes / 44 edges preserved; /api/admin/operations still 200. Frontend as Founder: /admin/ceo-briefing shows all 3 ⓘ (inspector-btn-ceo-enterprise_status/one_thing/autonomous_execution), drawer opens with widget name resolved ('Status Enterprise + Enterprise Score'), all 8 sections present (Scop, Valoare de business, Powered by, Database, Actualizare cron, Guvernat de (documente), Truth Engine (D161), Dependențe), close button works; clicking a doc chip 'D156 — Autonomous Execution Engine' navigates to /admin/knowledge-center?doc=memory%2Fboard%2Fdirectives%2FBOARD_DIRECTIVE_156_AUTONOMOUS_EXECUTION_ENGINE.md and auto-opens kc-doc-viewer. /admin/enterprise-health has inspector-btn-health-overall, /admin/operations has inspector-btn-ops-autonomous_followup (+ ops-autonomous-followup regression OK), /admin/war-room has inspector-btn-warroom-mission100 — all open drawer. /admin/explorer: explorer-title + registry-graph render, rg-stats='46/46 noduri · 44/44 relații 100% VERIFIED', engine/api/dashboard filters visible, search 'health' narrows to '9/46 noduri · 9/44 relații', clicking a node opens rg-node-panel with rg-node-name and VERIFIED badges. /admin/architecture: arch-title + arch-flow with all 11 clickable blocks (system_zero, client, enterprise_health verified), clicking enterprise_health opens arch-block-drawer with arch-open-doc + arch-open-explorer buttons; arch-mode-deps renders registry-graph. Security as admin (admin@propmanage.io): ⓘ buttons ABSENT from all 4 dashboards (ceo-briefing/enterprise-health/operations/war-room) while regression widgets (ceo-brief-autonomous, ops-autonomous-followup) still render; /admin/explorer → explorer-denied, /admin/architecture → arch-denied; sidebar contains NEITHER 'Enterprise Explorer' NOR 'Arhitectură' NOR 'Knowledge Center'. Regression: /admin/knowledge-center still fully functional as Founder (kc-title + kc-tab-map). Zero JS errors on any tested page.

issues: rg-stats renders as '46/46 noduri · 44/44 relații' (filtered/total format) whereas request spec quoted '46 noduri · 44 relații'. Format is arguably better because filters visibly change the numerator (e.g., '9/46 · 9/44' after search='health'), but flag for spec alignment.

'Refuz / Accept toate' banner still intercepts first click on freshly opened routes — must page.click('text=Refuz') before Inspector/Explorer/Architecture interactions. Cosmetic UX friction only, no functional break.

critical_code_review_comments: InspectorButton.jsx — the drawer's dependency chips (Powered by / Database / Documente / Dashboards) are rendered as <button> but only doc-refs starting with 'memory/' or 'docs/' are clickable; non-clickable chips render as disabled buttons — consider rendering them as spans to avoid confusing screen readers announcing 'button (disabled)'.

InspectorButton.jsx::InspectorDrawer — no keyboard ESC handler and no focus trap; clicking outside closes via overlay onClick, but keyboard users have no exit path. Same finding raised for KC DocViewer in iteration_130 — worth batching.

InspectorButton.jsx — axios call has no cleanup on unmount; if the user closes the drawer before the response returns, setD will fire on an unmounted component (React logs a warning). Use an AbortController or ignore flag.

EnterpriseExplorer.jsx / ArchitectureNavigator.jsx — the client-side gate (useFounderAccess) is duplicated logic vs the backend gate; when the network call to /access is slow, users may briefly see the guarded UI before it flips to *-denied. Consider rendering a loading skeleton while access is pending.

AdminLayoutMetronic sidebar — same 'inline OWNER_EMAILS' duplication flagged in iteration_130 still present; a single source (/api/founder/knowledge/access) would remove the duplication for the two new items too (Enterprise Explorer, Arhitectură).

widget_inspector.json / architecture_blocks.json — no schema validation on load; if a future edit drops a required field, the API silently returns partial data. Add a minimal Pydantic validation at boot to fail fast (Truth Engine D161 spirit).
seed_data_creation: None. Read-only feature backed by /app/backend/data/*.json — not mutated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: V2 Inspector + V3 Explorer + Architecture Navigator are stable. When re-testing UI, ALWAYS dismiss cookie banner (page.click('text=Refuz')) after each page.goto — banner reappears in fresh contexts. To read drawer sections use element.textContent (page.evaluate) rather than inner_text — inner_text on the fixed overlay wrapper occasionally missed off-viewport sections during testing (functional flow was unaffected). Wait for [data-testid="inspector-dependencies"] to guarantee the async /inspector fetch completed before assertions. Registry graph on /admin/architecture in 'deps' mode needs ~1.5s to mount after mode switch; add a wait_for_timeout(2000) or wait_for_selector for [data-testid="registry-graph"]. For hard logout use page.context.clear_cookies() + POST /api/auth/logout — the /logout SPA route wasn't reliable in this preview.
